summary: Route shopping-list creation through the verified protobuf operation and update cache only after read-back.
reason: The generic JSON POST used by lists create does not express AnyList's new-shopping-list operation. Preserve the live-verified protobuf request shape, require a read-after-write lookup by generated ID, and keep the local SQLite cache consistent with the verified response.
validated_outcome: Added request-construction coverage for the new-shopping-list protobuf operation, live read-back verification through the shared shopping-list resolver, and cache persistence coverage. Focused AnyList tests and go test ./... pass; no production AnyList data was mutated during validation.
